notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; there is no hardware backend and no hardware run. The package covers DroneNavigation-v0 only: DroneNavigation-v1 (drone_envs/__init__.py:7-10, a 16 x 16 camera plus 30 obstacle cubes) is not covered. The upstream pybullet environment was not run (the clone is read-only and its gym, pybullet, numpy and matplotlib dependencies are not installed where the gate ran); the fake backend is the package's pure Python kinematic point-mass reimplementation (fake.py) and was never compared with the upstream simulator. The implicit Gymnasium sim backend (gym.make('DroneNavigation-v0')) was not run. Five warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family driver because the bridge derives those schemas: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed on reset, seed on seed, ticks and action.values[*]). Only catalogue classes (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1) are used, so there are no catalogue requests. G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
